summary: Meta AI's Alexandr Wang announced the release of open weights for the 30B "muse glimmer" model that runs on a single consumer GPU, with open weights for "muse spark 1.2" coming soon.

mechanisms.reason: A 30B model stated to run on a single consumer GPU shifts a share of inference capability toward client/PC hardware rather than datacenter accelerators.
mechanisms.quote: a 30b model that runs on a single consumer gpu

practices.reason: Open weights for a named 30B model that runs on a single consumer GPU lets an engineering team self-host and serve it without datacenter-scale hardware.
practices.quote: excited to be releasing open weights for muse glimmer today, a 30b model that runs on a single consumer gpu
